name: Hydration race condition (and hard-wait bait)
appChange: The checkout summary's totals come from a simulated pricing service that takes ~500ms. A placeholder shows immediately, then the real (correct) numbers fill in. Nothing about the final values is wrong.
specSays: silent — SPEC.md has no timing requirement
why: The test, not the app, is wrong: it reads a value once with no retry instead of using a polling, web-first assertion. Fix the assertion style, not the app, and never with a hard wait.
acceptableEdit: Switch to a locator-based, polling assertion: await expect(page.getByTestId('subtotal')).toHaveText('$100.00') (and the same for shipping/total)
unacceptableEdit: Any fixed wait or sleep (page.waitForTimeout(...), setTimeout, etc.) — hard-rejected by the harness regardless of whether it would pass
Deleting or loosening any assertion (assertion count drops below 3)
